bio: This proposal, which has brought a large house back to life with a rustic atmosphere, has a markedly family ambiance and can be seen, due to the small size of the village in which it is located and the dining options in the surroundings, as... a real oasis of gastronomy! They only work with a surprise menu, not lacking in creativity, which captivates diners as soon as they start with the surprising selection of appetizers....
